children: Mahindra’s EV charging network now has 200 live charging points across India, with the company planning around 1,000 points by December 2027
Charge_iN by Mahindra has reached 50 operational EV charging stations across India, with the company planning to expand the network to 250 stations and around 1,000 charging points by December 2027.

The latest station has been installed at the HP Auto Care Centre in Sajgaon, Pune, on the Mumbai–Pune Expressway. It is the first Charge_iN facility to become operational as part of Mahindra’s agreement with Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited (HPCL).

Mahindra and HPCL had entered into an agreement in March 2026 to set up EV charging infrastructure at HPCL fuel stations across India. Other locations under the agreement are currently being developed.
The network currently has 200 live charging points across the country.

Charge_iN stations are equipped with 180 kW dual-gun chargers. Mahindra says these can charge its electric SUVs, the XEV 9e, BE 6 Sporteq and XEV 9S, from 20 per cent to 80 per cent in around 20 minutes.
The charging stations are being installed at locations along highways and other routes, with some sites located alongside restaurants and cafés.
Charge_iN is available to electric vehicles from different manufacturers and is not limited to Mahindra models.
Users can access the network through the Charge_iN by Mahindra app, Me4U app and other charging aggregator platforms. The company also plans to make the network available on the HP eCharge app.
Mahindra EV owners can also use the Me4U app to access around 35,000 public charging points operated by various charging point operators. These include HP eCharge stations.
Mahindra currently has 50 Charge_iN locations operational and plans to add another 200 stations to take the total to 250 by December 2027.
The company expects the expanded network to comprise approximately 1,000 charging points by that time.
The expansion will include additional locations being developed with HPCL, alongside other Charge_iN sites across the country.
